name: Extreme Heatwave
description: A scorching atmospheric heat dome settles over the metropolis, driving air conditioner demand and straining the grid.

name: Major Factory Closure
description: The largest heavy foundry closes down unexpectedly. Emissions plunge, but job losses devastate worker morale and tax revenue.

name: Transit Workers Strike
description: A sudden metro union walkout forces commuters into private cars and rideshares, jamming all major thoroughfares.
